description: Tighten three consecutive healthcheck timing lines of the worker service; the api service has identical lines. DISTILL-CANARY-b8050b51

files.README.md: Local stack. api and worker are tuned separately.
files.docker-compose.yml:
services:
  api:
    image: acme/api:2.7
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8000/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
  worker:
    image: acme/worker:2.7
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8100/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3

turns.prompt: In docker-compose.yml, make the worker's healthcheck stricter: interval 10s, timeout 3s, retries 5. Leave api as it is.
